public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 510;
    static int N, M, P;
    static int[][] comb = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] f1_dp = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] g1_dp = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] f2_dp = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] g2_dp = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % P;
            }
        }

        f1_dp[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            f1_dp[i] = 0;
            g1_dp[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long temp1 = ((long)f1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j]) % P;
                long temp2 = ((long)f1_dp[j - 1] * g1_dp[i - j] + (long)g1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j]) % P;
                f1_dp[i] = (int)((f1_dp[i] + temp1 * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % P);
                int t = (int)((temp2 * (i + 1)) % P);
                long g_temp = ((long)f1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j]) % P;
                long g_part = (g_temp + (long)g1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j]) % P;
                g_part = (g_part * (i + 1)) % P;
                g1_dp[i] = (int)((g1_dp[i] + (g_temp * (comb[j][2] + comb[i - j + 1][2]) + t) % P * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % P);
            }
            f1_dp[i] = (int)(((long)(i + 1) * f1_dp[i]) % P);
        }

        g2_dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, M); j++) {
                f2_dp[i][j] = f2_dp[i - 1][j];
                g2_dp[i][j] = g2_dp[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long f_val = (i - k != 0) ? f2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] : 1;
                    f2_dp[i][j] = (int)((f2_dp[i][j] + f_val * f1_dp[k] % P * comb[j][k]) % P);
                    long g_val = (i - k != 0) ? f2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] : 1;
                    long g_part = ((g_val * g1_dp[k]) + ((i - k != 0) ? g2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] : 0) * f1_dp[k]) % P;
                    g2_dp[i][j] = (int)((g2_dp[i][j] + g_part * comb[j][k]) % P);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(g2_dp[N][M]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
